title: Demo manifest
description: Everything the portal needs to build a demo page. The portal reads nothing else.

slug.description: Folder name. The only identity a demo has — never change it after publishing.

group.description: The section of the portal's index the demo is listed in. Titles and order are in scripts/prepare-portal.ts.

stage.description: How tall the demo's frame is in the portal: small 400px, medium 520px, large the rest of the first screen. Pick the smallest that fits the demo with its menus open. Large when left out.

icons.description: Icons by their Lordicon name, as the files in shared/public/icons are named (system-outline-94-lock). The export ships these, plus the pager's arrows.

iconStates.description: The states the demo plays, by icon, as named in the icon's file without the ratio (morph-select). An icon left out plays its default state. The portal shows them in the icon table.

iconsNote.description: What to know about the icons and their states, after the shared sentence about the Animation state column. Shown above the portal's icon table.

note.description: One line of context, shown under the title in the portal.

codepen.description: The published pen, filled in by hand after saving it. The portal shows an Open in CodePen button when it is set.
